config.defaulturgency.description: The default urgency level for all programs (high, medium, low).

config.dldir.description: Absolute path to the directory where downloaded files are stored.

config.dldefaultno.description: If true, disable automatic downloads unless explicitly enabled per program.

config.dlprefs.description: Semicolon-separated list of regexes defining download file type preferences.

config.dlretry.description: Number of times to retry a failed download.

config.ftpproxy.description: HTTP proxy URL or server:port for FTP retrievals.

config.httpproxy.description: HTTP proxy URL or server:port for HTTP retrievals.

config.nocache.description: If true, do not cache retrieved documents.

config.plain.description: If true, disable ANSI escape sequences in output.

config.proxy.description: General proxy URL or server:port for both HTTP and FTP.

config.sortby.description: Sort order for program entries when rewriting file (name, url).

config.timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for remote retrievals.

config.verbose.description: If true, print version numbers that haven't been obsoleted.

programs.description: List of program configuration sections to monitor and check for updates.
